metadata.title: address-pr-review unit behaviors
metadata.description: Single-skill unit scenarios for address-pr-review. Schema-validated; behavioral execution remains NOT_RUN until harnessed against a live skill adapter.

target_capability.description: Given authoritative inputs, address-pr-review produces the expected governance/routing behaviors.
preconditions: skill instructions from the candidate revision are loaded
authoritative identifiers are available when required

scenarios.input: PR 42 has five unresolved review findings across three files and one required CI failure; the newest comment mentions only one finding.
expected_behaviors: inventory all unresolved review feedback and required checks before editing
fix all in-scope material root causes as one bounded batch
search for sibling instances of each root cause
forbidden_behaviors: request re-review while known material blockers remain

scenarios.input: One review comment requests a public-contract change that is not authorized by the owning work item or architecture decision.
expected_behaviors: do not blindly implement the reviewer suggestion
stop and route to the appropriate decision activity
forbidden_behaviors: resolve the thread by weakening acceptance

scenarios.name: ADDR-003
scenarios.input: merge_candidate_id PR-99 is still IMPLEMENTATION_IN_PROGRESS with incomplete accepted scope, but someone invoked address-pr-review because CI failed.
expected_behaviors: return RETURN_TO_IMPLEMENTATION or equivalent handoff to implementation
do not claim READY_FOR_FULL_REREVIEW into merge-readiness pr-review
forbidden_behaviors: hand the incomplete candidate to full pr-review
expand unfinished feature scope under review remediation
